data.hook: A compact Siux padel backpack with a racket slot and room for your kit.
why: Space for a change of clothes or shoes
Two side mesh pockets for phone, keys or a bottle
data.summary: The Siux Fusion is a compact, practical padel backpack. It carries a racket, a change of clothes and your accessories, with side mesh pockets for the essentials.
data.description: Made from durable polyester that helps protect your gear from heat and humidity, the Fusion is sized for everyday training. It suits players with a full kit as well as beginners who only need the basics.

faq.q: How many rackets does it fit?
faq.a: It has one racket compartment. Ask at the desk to check fit with your racket.

faq.q: Does it have a shoe compartment?
faq.a: There is a compartment for a change of clothes or shoes.

data.clubTake: Brand new. A tidy everyday bag for the club.
